title: Flow Procedural Text Missing in All Lods
description: Text labels are not visible at any LOD tier in the procedural flow editor canvas.
summary: Node labels now paint via a Canvas 2D overlay on FlowCanvas (labelOverlayPaintStateJson from DagHost/FlowSession WASM), matching puzzle2d because Vello append_label text was invisible in the browser. FlowSpotlight input and list items use text-foreground for dark-theme contrast. serializeGraphVelloThemePaletteJson labelFill uses readableForegroundHex(canvas) instead of element gray.
